jsonld_raw.name: VETIVER MANGO CAR AIR FRESHENER
jsonld_raw.description:
Car air freshener.

Vetiver Mango | Tropical and green, like a breath of fruit in the sun.

Notes:
Top notes: mango, apple.
Heart notes: Java vetiver.
Base notes: milk accord, vanilla.

Comes in a fabric pouch with a hanging ribbon. Includes a metal clip for the vent mesh.
